kicker: Electronics · component and chip plants coming online
title: India's electronics parts plants arrive over two years
dek: Kaynes' first PCB revenue and Ratnaveer's laminate trial land this quarter, Dixon's display line by early 2027. Syrma's PCB plant reaches series output by September 2027 and its laminate plant around December 2028.

read: The parts plants arrive one at a time through 2028, so imported boards and long lead times stay the norm until at least FY28.
sources: Vantage analysis of Q1–Q2 FY27 earnings calls of Kaynes Technology, Dixon Technologies, Syrma SGS, Ratnaveer Precision, Minda Corporation and Centum Electronics; Vantage sector intel, 21 Nov 2026
notes: Each bar runs from mid-November 2026 to the end of the period management gave on its Q2 FY27 call (Q3 FY27 = December 2026, Q4 FY27 = March 2027). Kaynes had guided ₹450–500 cr of chip-packaging and PCB revenue for FY27 on its Q1 call; both units are now running but products are still in customer approval, and the company says the timeline has slipped by a couple of quarters. Dixon's display timing comes from its Q1 FY27 call (trials from early Q3, mass production end-Q3 or early Q4) and was repeated on its Q2 call; Minda's TFT display-module plant has a start of production about 18 months out, so its date is approximate. Ratnaveer's first CCL line (15 lakh sheets) is due for trial runs from 20 December 2026, with five lines by April 2028. Plant dates are management targets, not commitments.
